enrichment.headline: Moves about $1.1M in unclaimed payment funds from stale-dated checks into the General Fund
enrichment.summary: The Board adopts a resolution moving money from old district checks that were never cashed (stale-dated warrants) into the General Fund, as California law allows, for 2019-20 as of May 31, 2020. The official text lists two counts of checks (2,690 and 2680) and two amounts ($1,104,758.00 and $1,069,434.46), so the exact figure is unclear from the text alone.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.sourceIssue: The text states two check counts (2,690 and 2680) and two cumulative amounts ($1,104,758.00 and $1,069,434.46) without saying which applies.
items.title: Transfer of Unclaimed Property Funds From Their Respective Fund(s) - To General Fund – Pursuant to California Government Code Section 50053 [FY 2019-20 - As of May 31, 2020]

enrichment.headline: Adopts updated salary schedules for substitute teachers in the Oakland Education Association unit
enrichment.summary: The Board adopts a resolution setting salary schedules for substitute certificated (teaching) positions covered by the Oakland Education Association (OEA). It lists past raises dating back to 2007, plus daily rates for short- and long-term substitutes and a 3% increase for child development and adult education substitutes effective January 1, 2019 and January 1, 2020. No total dollar amount is stated.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Accepts $750,000 from the Stupski Foundation for college and career advising support

enrichment.headline: Expands student data sharing with the Oakland Housing Authority at no cost
enrichment.summary: This amends an existing memorandum of understanding (a partnership agreement) between the district and the Housing Authority of the City of Oakland. The district would share student directory information, combined test-result data, and information on students' device and internet access for students in households that get housing assistance. All other terms stay the same, and there is no fiscal impact.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
